facts.claim: The structure is a peripteral Doric temple incorporating Ionic architectural features.
Outer peristyle has eight columns at the ends and seventeen down each long side.
The Ionic frieze ran around the upper outer walls of the cella.
The Ionic frieze comprised 115 blocks and had a total length of approximately 160 metres.
The building campaign began in 447 BCE and the temple structure was completed in 438 BCE.
